location: Phelps Mill County Park carry-in access, Otter Tail River, Minnesota
coordinateInterpretation: Minnesota DNR Water Access Sites GPS point for the public natural-surface carry-in access; not a surveyed wet-toe coordinate.
accessCondition: Hand-carry only; portage across the park lawn and launch west of the parking area. The county says there are no conventional boat-launch facilities. Check current park notices.

evidence.claim: Minnesota DNR feature 2258 / WAS00559 identifies Phelps Mill as administered by Otter Tail County, Carry-In launch, Natural surface, and publishes GPS geometry at 46.3821666505, -95.8210176143.
evidence.sourceType: Minnesota DNR Water Access Sites GIS feature

evidence.claim: Minnesota DNR lists Phelps Mill County Park carry-in access at river mile 85 and directs paddlers to portage across the park lawn and launch west of the parking area.
evidence.sourceType: Minnesota DNR State Water Trail route guide

evidence.claim: Otter Tail County confirms the public park and states there are no boat-launch facilities, clarifying that paddlers should expect hand-carry access rather than a conventional trailer ramp.

The two route occurrences share the official access coordinate; pre-review, the selected endpoint was 521 feet from the named flowline and 181 feet from mapped water, with complete hydrography coverage.
